Prop Haunt Patch Notes: 9/2/2025

Thank you everyone for playing and providing feedback and bug reports! I'm pushing out some small fixes that have been reported over the past couple of days. As always, please leave feedback and bug reports either in the Steam Discussions or on the Discord! 

🔊 Audio


 Fixed an issue where the Investigator was able to hear the Ritual Orbs
 Fixed an issue where the Zap sound was global and ignored audio settings.
 Fixed an issue where the Zap sound would spam when zapping a Ghost.


🎮 Gameplay


 Fixed an issue where Ritual Orb/Room destruction would incorrectly slow the Investigator if off the camera.
 Fixed an issue where the Ghosts were able to use their Ultimate while stunned.
 Fixed a bug where all Ghosts were teleported during room destruction, even if they weren't in the room.
 Fixed an issue where control settings were not loaded correctly during the tutorial. 


🖥️ UI / UX


 Fixed a bug where the Teleport screen would not disappear sometimes.
 Fixed a bug where the Loading screen would not disappear sometimes.
 Disabled the functions to Unready players in the Lobby when a new player joined. This was causing confusion.

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
Another playtest is wrapped up, and big changes for the Prop Haunts demo come with it! Before I dive into all the changes you can expect, please take my heartfelt THANK YOU! None of these changes would have been possible without player feedback during the playtests and the public demo.

Even though the playtests are officially over, as I prepare for the Early Access release (I can’t believe August 29th is already almost here), that doesn’t mean changes aren’t coming. There is still so much more to add to Prop Haunt before 1.0, such as new maps, new haunts, and more! 

I’ll be looking closely at player feedback and reports to continue to make Prop Haunt the best it can be with your help. Join the official Discord to report. Thank you again!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/611fdc15d699ab5eac3ab3babd7870471c15dd58.jpg"]New map in the works: Police Department



Find the patch notes below and enjoy the biggest demo update to date!
Prop Haunt Demo Updates

👻 Features
New Haunt: Facing Haunt. Haunted Prop will turn to face the camera while actively being watched.

New Haunt: Object Swap. This Haunt will replace the Prop with a similar but different Prop. (E.g., one kind of chair with a different kind of chair). Props that can be haunted this way randomize their starting Prop, giving some replayability to each level.

New Haunt: Toggle Lights. Some lights are now randomized on or off at the start of the match. This Haunt will toggle it to the other state.

New Ghost ability: Possess. Possess a Prop, then Haunt it. When your Prop gets reported, it triggers a jump scare for the investigator.

Match search now lists all lobbies sorted in the following order:

Public joinable

Public Full

Private

In Match

New interactive tutorial for Ghosts and Investigators

Camera controls moved to WASD and QE, away from mouse movement.
⚖️ Balance Changes
Added a short 2-second cooldown for Haunts.

Haunt’s abilities are now charge-based and customizable in Match Settings. 

Removed limit of Haunts per room.

Investigator Scan ability is now instant, and the Investigator can switch between rooms while activated to hunt Ghosts.

Ghosts are now visible while in Haunt or Possess mode.

Ghosts now have a trail behind them when moving.

Reduced the stun effect for ghosts by half. 

Increased the amount of Influence needed to perform Rituals. Sorry Ghosts, the wins were happening a little too easily.

New Match Settings in the settings menu for customization:

The number of Haunt charges Ghosts have.

If Prop possession is always usable or only without Haunt charges.

Investigator difficulty. Easy setting for the investigator makes Ritual Orbs take more power to be destroyed. 

A timer is displayed in the Investigator warehouse to let players know how long they have until they are auto-teleported back to the ritual site.
🎵UI and Audio
New Icons for Ghost Abilities.

New Icons for Investigator abilities.

New UI for Ghost to better display game state. 

Fixed UI conflicts on the scoreboard.

New UI system for Ghost and Investigators.

Improved location of mute button on scoreboard.

All players can now hear the Scan Ability sound. It is now loudest if in the same room with you.

The lobby now has a spectator role, so full parties can easily be held between the investigator and the ghosts. This is not a spectator role in-game. Just a place to change roles in the lobby.

Replaced the font with a more legible one.

Improved flow of UI in the Lobby. WorldUI Pins disappear to make selecting options easier.
🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed bug where the game wouldn’t return to the lobby if the hunter left mid-match.

Fixed translation errors.

The demo acceptance UI is fixed and only appears once now as intended.

Fixed the issue where controls would incorrectly disappear on the bottom right.

Fixed the issue where the resize haunt would reset after a while.

Fixed issue where spamming E to sit down at the Investigator computer would break controls.

Fixed Props that weren’t haunting correctly in the kitchen, bathroom, and living room.

Fixed the issue with crates hiding the mouse not clearing correctly when found.

Fixed the issue where the Investigator sometimes couldn’t interact with the crates.

Fixed the issue where lobby doesn’t clear from search when starting a game.

Fixed the issue where the last player to join didn’t get set as Investigator.

Fixed the issue with cooldowns on warehouse Props were not working.

Fixed the issue with friends list not showing friends for non-host players in the lobby.

Fixed the crash that happens when returning to the lobby.

Fixed bug where changing master volume wouldn’t change other audio volumes.

Fixed bug where the Investigator's ability power was reset to 0 when getting back on the cameras from the warehouse.

Fixed bug where the Ritual Orbs were visible to the Investigator when looking at the computer screen with the camera pointed at an orb.

No longer able to start a match with 1 player.

Fixed a bug where Ghosts were able to body block the report action, preventing the Investigator from reporting haunts.

Fixed a bug where Ghost’s could see the world indicator for the Investigator when the lights are out

Fixed a bug where using your ultimate as a Ghost while it was on the global cooldown would apply a permanent cooldown, preventing any usage of the ult even if you had charges. 

Fixed a bug that spam populated the Haunt Detected warning, which would also overwrite the Missing USB Device error, leading to confusion. Now, nothing will change if a new haunt is detected and the warning is already present.

notes.title: Prop Haunt Demo Update
notes.content:
👻 Features & Additions:
Clearer Tutorials. 

The tutorials are now interactive.

Voice Chat and Mute option.

Added Haunt for Ghosts.

The Prop slowly turns towards the camera while the Investigator is in the same room as the Prop.

Additional ways to scare the Investigators, both on and off-camera.

Fake Haunts.

The camera now indicates to the Investigator when there is an active Haunt in a room.

Ghosts can “Fake” a Haunt to make the indicator appear in a room even if there isn’t a Haunt happening. This ability only has a cooldown and does not use ability power cost.

The selected Ghost and its color remain between matches now. No need to keep changing back to the color you want after a match.

Switched to charge-based Haunt system:

Players are no longer limited to 1 Haunt per room.

Ghosts now start with 3 charges of their Haunt ability, and use them to haunt props. One haunt = one charge.

One charge returns every 30 seconds.

Ghosts are now visible when in Haunt mode to increase risk vs reward.
⚖️Balance Changes
Investigator Scan ability is now instant. The investigator can switch cameras while it’s active, and ghosts are slowed down during it. 

The required AP to destroy the orb is now scaled with the number of Ghosts in a match.

Ghosts now teleport back to the room where they used their ultimate after haunting a prop in the warehouse.
🎧UI/Audio Updates
Scan ability sound is now global. Loudest when in the room with players and quieter when being used in a different location.

Lobby now has a spectator role so that full parties can more easily change between Investigator and Ghosts. This is not a spectator role for in-game, and only works in the Lobby.
🛠️Bug Fixes:
Fixed bug where the game wouldn’t return to the lobby if the hunter left mid-match.

Translation errors fixed.

Controls no longer incorrectly disappear on the bottom right.

Resize Haunt no longer resets after time passes.

Spamming E to sit down at the Investigator computer no longer breaks controls.

Fixed props that weren’t haunting correctly in the kitchen, bathroom, and living room.

Fixed issue with crates hiding the mouse and not clearing correctly when found.

The investigator can now always interact with the crates.

Fixed the Lobby not clearing from the search before starting a game.

Fixed issue where the last player to join didn’t get set as the Investigator.

Cooldowns on warehouse props, which allowed for Ghosts to spam Haunts on them, are now fixed.

Fixed issue with friends list not showing friends for non-host players in the lobby.
🪲Known issues being worked on:
The game crashes when the host plays a Ghost and ends the match. This doesn’t happen if the host played the Investigator.

If you have feedback or run into a bug, please report it on the official Discord server. Thank you and happy haunting!

notes.title: Major Update for Prop Haunt’s Demo!
notes.content:
Hello Ghouls and Investigators! 

I have big news, as you might’ve seen from the title, Prop Haunt’s demo just got its biggest update yet, and it’s all thanks to YOU! These changes come directly from the second playtest, from all the feedback we received from it. 

Prop Haunt will also be participating in the June Next Fest, now with a demo that’s bigger and better than ever, all thanks to your input!

Of course, if you run into any bugs, please join our Discordto report them. Thank you and happy haunting!

Patch Notes

📑Major Additions

 Implemented multiple localizations
 Scan ability for Investigator implemented

 1.5 minute cooldown
 Ghosts have to hide or be zapped when they become visible.
 The investigator is prevented from changing cameras after Scan is activated.
 Ghosts can’t use their abilities during the scan. Added Notifications and a countdown for the scanner
 Added new tutorial messages to drive players through their first match
 Lobby global voice chat
 Team-based voice chat in-game
🖥️Gameplay & UI Changes Updated “Charge Room” to “Ritual” 
 The pause menu now appears over the rest of UI in game
 Pressing escape now closes the teleport menu
 Ultimate orb now indicates if it can be used or not and is shared between Ghosts.
 Updated all abilities UI components to reflect whether they can be used or not based on cooldowns/ability power
 Teleport menu: grayed out destroyed rooms so players can’t teleport to them
 Added player list for lobby👻Ghost Changes Ghosts now get influence for haunting props in the Investigator’s warehouse
 Ghosts are now visible when charging the orbs
 Reduced rate at which ghosts grow in size and realness
⚖️Balance Changes Reduced rate of AP gain for the Investigator  
 Reduced camera turn rate
 Reduced rate of miasma growth on haunted props
 Reduced the initial cost of Investigator’s ultimate from 5AP to 1AP
💀Misc.  Added sound effects for when the room is destroyed
 Feedback when zapping a ghost has been added
 Added music to the main menu, lobby, and house.
🐛Bug Fixes Fixed bug where opening the pause menu before the match started would break controls for ghosts
 Haunting the window lamp in the kitchen is fixed.
 Haunting the Reading light in the living room is fixed
 Haunting the Spray bottle in the bathroom is fixed
 Fixed bug where ghosts haunt ability wouldn’t be blocked when teleporting into the room where the Investigator is
 Fixed issue where the second time the mouse was haunted in the investigator warehouse, it didn't clear the effects 
 Fixed issues with cooldowns not applying to haunts in the Investigator warehouse
 Fixed issue with being able to hold down Q/E and spam the failed ability noise
 Fixed lobby performance issues
 Fixed issue with AP continuing to drain after leaving the Investigator warehouse
 Fixed the world UI pin showing on the customization screen
 Mouse/box sounds in Investigator Warehouse audible for everyone fixed
 Some props were not accruing Miasma correctly.
 All props that were affected by this are now fixed
 Kicking a player in the lobby now correctly opens the spot for another player to join
 Preventing input before loaded into the match should fix some control issues
 Hearing other ghosts getting zapped is fixed
 Mouse now appears at end game correctly
 Ghost zapped audio spam is fixed

Thank you everyone who has played and provided feedback!

Today is the first post-demo launch update, improving some visuals, fixing some bugs, and first attempts at balancing (Ghosts were winning a little too much). Read the patch notes below for more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/4dae7096d5e5d965d77c53a981456c497025a417.png

Demo Patch Notes

More balancing!

 Reduced the rate at which Ghosts fill up the orbs in each room from 5% to 4%.


Visual improvements

 Orbs have a new appearance and are more obvious when being charged.
 Added UI elements for the Investigator in the lobby to see who is in the lobby and their ready status. The Investigator can now invite friends from the UI too!


Bug Fixes

 Fixed haunts on a handful of props (the mop in the bathroom was very good at hiding it was haunted).
 Fixed an issue in the lobby where players would sometimes not appear in the lobby.
 Fixed an issue in the lobby where the Investigator could Ready, then switch roles or leave the game and the Ready status wouldn't reset, allowing the game to be started without one. 
 Fixed an issue in the match where a Ghost would see the previous room props while haunting if they get zapped by the Investigator.
 Fixed an issue with overlapping effects for Stunned and Locked. The Stunned effect would sometimes hang around too long after being zapped.


There's more to come, so stay tuned! If you run into a bug head on over to our community Discord.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Welcome To Prop Haunt
notes.content:
Hello ghouls and investigators!

Welcome to my first official Devlog!

Before I begin, huge thanks to everyone who jumped into Prop Haunt’s very first playtest and gave feedback. I couldn’t (and wouldn’t want to) do this without your help!

While I parse through feedback, bugs and features in preparation for the upcoming demo, here’s a brief intro to what Prop Haunt is and what’s in the works. Enjoy!

Prop Haunt’s early beginnings.

Now, if you’ve played ‘I’m on Observation Duty’ and ‘Prop Hunt’, you might have noticed some similarities between those and Prop Haunt. You’d be right, the idea was born while playing with friends when one of them said, “Why hasn’t anyone made a game combining this and Prop Hunt yet!?”.

In the middle of Udemy UE4 courses and a desire to make a multiplayer game, I said: “Why don’t we?”.

Prop Haunt was born! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/c70285fa0467a9b925ac199cbc291e1b20c7abcc.jpg
Before I could make my own ghosts, yeah..it started like that. Thanks marketplace!

Development began in earnest in April 2024. It started as a family affair, my wife joining me to make the very first house level. Eventually, I’d be working alone again due to time constraints, but with help from the marketplace place I’d make due.

Being one person, sometimes you have to just work with what you have to get anything done at all.

Prop Haunt’s Growth

As with most early stages of anything, learning was the biggest challenge. I was determined to learn how to do the rigging and animation on my own. Meanwhile, knowing art is not my strongest suit, I outsourced concept and technical art like shaders and 3D models to companies and friends, then rigged/animated them myself. No more Pac-Man ghost!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/1c8e4709f0405b608f41e9a149e13d94d3d1fc7e.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/9246240913f69726c7a72bca17f9b2d86793260b.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/d6b91bffc50b0b0fc9830ab2b29ea2d822feed18.png

Not a bad upgrade from the marketplace ghost, huh?

And of course, there is the challenge of gameplay. This is something ongoing and not just changing with my input, but players as well. Recently, the first playtest ended, during which I was lucky enough to receive vital and well-thought-out feedback about gameplay.

From cursor suggestions, balance issues for both ghosts and investigators, messaging clarity and more, I’ll be working on in preparation for the upcoming demo on April 18th.

Prop Haunt Now

Which brings us to the current state of Prop Haunt. Still in the early stages of development, there are bound to be many changes, especially with player feedback. Something I’m constantly looking for and gathering. As a labor of love, this game just isn’t possible without you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/92e2e4033c213c1b6ddf575958914e889ea52537.png
Based on feedback from the playtest, I’ll be busy making changes for the demo, including: 

    Rebalancing powers for Ghosts and the Investigator.
    Re-visiting the Level length.
    Better tutorial and clarity for game mechanics, such as what ultimate's do, the Investigator's job, and more. 
General polishing before the demo for a better experience and more feedback before early access.

The future also holds several improvements and additions as well. Later this month, you can expect these updates for starters.

    Hunter trap system
    “Trap” props so that when the Ghosts try to haunt it, it stuns them.
    Balancing and bug improvements from demo reports. To give feedback, please join our community on Discord. 
Second map created, lobby updated to change floor based on selected map.
Steam achievements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/c828ab78ffa4150b6cad6c1660d37d839c545482.png

Thank you for checking out Prop Haunt! I’m very excited to be working, improving and building it with you. Join the community on Discord and keep your eyes open for more updates and news on the demo, coming April 17th.

Happy hauntings and I’ll see you in-game soon.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471647/56f24262eed0cd9c35dac56cac63d92bba8212aa.png
